relations.role: Epigraphist to the Government of India
relations.evidence: in 1882 I was selected for the newly-created post of Epigraphist to the Government of India, with the primary duty of preparing the volume that was to contain the Inscriptions of the Early Gupta Kings. I joined that appointment on the 17th January, 1883 ; and held it up to the 4th June, 1886, when it was abolished
